questions.stem: A data set has two modes. This data is described as:
questions.explanation: When a data set has two values that share the highest frequency, it is called bimodal (two modes).

questions.stem: Which average can be used for qualitative (non-numerical) data?
questions.explanation: The mode is the only average that can be found for qualitative data (e.g. the most popular colour). The mean and median require numerical data.
